$description: Design-file only: layer-opacity switches, in percent, that show one of two stacked shapes per theme, for things a token can't recolor (the light and dark static maps on the Audio post type board). Bind a layer's opacity to one of these. The site does this with <picture>/prefers-color-scheme, so no CSS reads this file. Synced to FigCraft by npm run figcraft:tokens, names verbatim.
